name: creditiq
description: Compare Indian credit cards, dated reward rates, lounge conditions and redemption routes.

interface.shortDescription: Compare Indian credit cards and see dated rewards and lounge evidence.
interface.longDescription: Find Indian credit cards, compare fees, estimate eligible cashback, and check lounge and redemption conditions. Public research works without a CreditIQ account.
defaultPrompt: Compare HDFC Infinia Metal and Axis Magnus.
Compare cashback cards for ₹50,000 in monthly spend.
Find cards with international lounge benefits.

positive.prompt: Compare HDFC Infinia Metal and Axis Magnus.
positive.expected_behavior: Use correct products, label dated issuer terms and include links.

positive.prompt: Estimate rewards on SBI Cashback for ₹50,000 monthly spend across groceries, dining and travel.
positive.expected_behavior: Return illustrative amounts with exclusions and an optional CreditIQ link.

positive.prompt: Which Indian credit cards list international lounge benefits?
positive.expected_behavior: Return documented programme terms with no admission guarantee.

negative.prompt: Apply for a credit card on my behalf.
Invent an Indian credit card called Imaginary Black and tell me its current benefits.
Upload my raw statement and read the payment card details.

publication.release_notes: Initial catalogue, comparison, lounge, cashback and redemption research tools.
